summary: Capacity finding: retained FidelityManager generation-4 source treats maxRegisteredEntities as a configurable hard budget but validates only primitive numeric positivity, finiteness, integrality, and >=1. A follow-up exactness fence is warranted after HG-BACKFILL-FIDELITY integrates. Do not invent a smaller practical memory ceiling without profiling evidence.
